name: PAGE ONE
description: Page One is a traditional Japanese card game that combines follow-suit trick-taking mechanics with a shedding objective. Players must follow the led suit or draw from the stock until they find a playable card. The game is known for its mandatory 'Page One!' declaration when a player is down to their final card, with failure to declare resulting in a severe five-card penalty.

content.text: Page One is a traditional Japanese card game that combines follow-suit trick-taking mechanics with a shedding objective. Players must follow the led suit or draw from the stock until they find a playable card. The game is known for its mandatory 'Page One!' declaration when a player is down to their final card, with failure to declare resulting in a severe five-card penalty.
Developed in Japan during the 1950s and 1960s, it predates the 'American' Crazy Eights variant that often shares its name.
Typically four players sit in a circle; play and dealing proceed in a clockwise direction.
Standard 52-card pack with one added Joker. Rank: Joker > Ace > King > Queen > Jack > 10 > 9 > 8 > 7 > 6 > 5 > 4 > 3 > 2.
One standard pack of cards, one Joker, and a playing surface for the central trick pile.
The dealer distributes four cards to each player one at a time. The remaining cards form the face-down stock.

items.text: Five-Card Start: Players start with five cards each instead of four to extend the length of the game deal.
Restricted Joker: The Joker can only be played if the player has no cards of the led suit in their hand.
No Joker Last: Players are not permitted to win the game by playing the Joker as their final card.
